scope: Previously explored 2023-2024 development diagnostics, not an untouched test or a current forecast
hypothesis: The previously defined joint volume-spike and same-day price-direction state may add predictive information conditional on the previously defined MA state
authorization: User: 继续按照计划往下进行; assistant research choices, not user trading parameters
input_features: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/日线特征与信号.sqlite
input_labels: outputs/三线研究启动_20261025/量价基线/开发期结果隔离.sqlite
event: C[t+5]/O[t+1]-1 > 0; zero joins nonpositive and is counted separately
signal_time: After signal-date close under source assumptions; no intraday timing or certified historical first availability
volume_price_definition: Existing signals: volume > 1.5 * previous 20 same-segment observations excluding current AND close_change_prev > 0 / < 0; both zero is other, including flat-price spikes; either NULL abstains
missing_policy: Any missing MA or volume-price signal excludes the date from all three models' training and scoring; never fill missing with zero
denominator_definition: n/k count the same joint-complete training pool for all models; nMA/kMA count all parent members in that pool; nCell/kCell count its subcell members
boolean_validation: Only 0/1/NULL signal values; simultaneous opposite MA or volume-price signals are rejected
shrinkage_interpretation: Fixed empirical shrinkage with overlapping prior data; not a Bayesian posterior or an uncertainty interval
insufficient_training_policy: Joint training n<100 -> all three models abstain for entire fold; no previous-fold fallback, expanded dates or threshold reduction
empty_cell_policy: M1 empty MA -> p0; M2 empty cell -> pMA; store n=0 and prior_only=1
training_policy: Expanding development history, signal_date and actual label end strictly before validation start; joint feature mask for every model; fit once and freeze within quarter
validation_policy: Actual label end <= fold end; same dates and outcomes for M0/M1/M2; retain all registered ex-date and development-end exclusions
comparators: Refit M0/M1 on this joint eligible training pool; never directly compare new scores with previous unmatched scores
primary_comparison: M2 minus matched M1 pooled Brier, lower is better; report all folds, no significance or automatic promotion
fixed_grid: Every fifth original 2023-2024 anchor starting 2023-01-03; no phase selection; not certified independent
fixed_grid_construction: Construct i%5==0 from all original anchors before feature/label exclusions, then intersect with joint eligible validation dates; never reindex after filtering
reporting_requirements: All six folds and all nine cells including empty cells; n/k/p and prior-only indicators, paired date scores, coverage losses against prior run
followup_policy: Preserve all results; no threshold/group/lambda retuning this round. Review repeated development evidence before separately registering any next phase. No automatic opening of 2025/2026 outcomes.
